stories.title: Liquid Network: ~4,000 BTC out Sunday; Tuesday wires say ~3,400 returned
facts: Sun: purported white-hats withdrew ~4,000 BTC (~$320M) from Liquid’s federation wallet that backs L-BTC — ~95% of ~4,200 BTC reserves (Cointelegraph / Decrypt).
Path: bug-minted unbacked L-BTC pegged out via SideSwap’s PAK; federation keys not compromised; bridge nodes disabled; other Liquid assets (USDT etc.) untouched.
On-chain negotiation: actors demand Elements patch on every node before returning most coins; Blockstream exchanged PGP-signed BTC messages (Cointelegraph update).

Tue midday DE wire (Golem ~12:39): “Hacker stehlen 4.000 Bitcoin und geben 3.400 wieder zurück.” EN Google News also headlines CoinDesk/Yellow: ~3,400 returned / ~598 still out — treat as tip until publisher page loads.
stories.whyItMatters: A federated Bitcoin sidechain lost nearly all reserve BTC without a key theft — mint-then-peg-out — and recovery is still incomplete while the bridge stays paused.

stories.title: Australia: “My Feed, My Way” — draft duty of care with algorithm opt-out
facts: PM Albanese / Comms Minister Wells (Tue): draft Digital Duty of Care for targeted consultation; legislation aimed this year.
“My Feed, My Way”: platforms must notify users 16+ and let them opt out of personalized algorithm feeds — follow-only default instead.
Also covers games/apps/AI chatbots for under-18s (eating disorders, misogyny, porn, crime/stunts, severe distress); eSafety can issue removal notices.
Non-compliance penalties up to A$109.2m; Albanese to push the pitch at UNGA later this month (Guardian / pm.gov.au).
stories.whyItMatters: After the under-16 social ban, Canberra is exporting a recommender-opt-out model with nine-figure fines — a template Europe will watch.

stories.title: Buckmaster: forced Euler blowup with LLMs — and an OpenAI pressure story
facts: NYU’s Tristan Buckmaster + Anthropic’s Levent Alpöge publish finite-time blowup (smooth forcing) for incompressible porous media, Boussinesq, and 3D Euler; hypo-dissipative Navier–Stokes Lean not ready (statement.pdf).
Credit Córdoba / Martínez-Zoroa’s forced-blowup program; heavy Claude / Codex (GPT-5.6 Sol) / Astra use — Euler writeup called “AI slop” under time pressure.

Claims: after rumors reached OpenAI, Sebastien Bubeck joined Sun calls; internal model supposedly had forced NS; proposals included joint posting and removing Alpöge from authorship; “Why would you ruin your career?”
Buckmaster: has not seen OpenAI’s proof; not accusing training theft; stating what was said. HN ~276 on the PDF.
stories.whyItMatters: A Clay-adjacent fluid breakthrough collides with lab rivalry and credit politics — the math and the conduct claims both need primary reading, not summary-of-summaries.

stories.title: PISA 2025: OECD reading freefall; Germany worse again
facts: heise on OECD release: OECD reading −28 pts 2015→2025; math −22; science “comparatively stable” over 10y (Cormann).
Germany vs 2022: science 486 (was 492), reading 465 (480), math 464 (475) — below PISA 2000 too.
“Flüchtiges Lesen” nearly doubled globally 2018–2025; Schleicher ties habits to social feeds / less leisure reading.
New domain “Lernen in der digitalen Welt” — detailed results autumn 2027; DE ~498 vs OECD 500 on early LDW cut.
stories.whyItMatters: Reading is the load-bearing skill for everything else — and Germany’s slide continues while half of 15-year-olds already use AI chatbots weekly for learning.
